# Force reload and test m2
import sys
mods_to_remove = [k for k in list(sys.modules.keys()) if 'semver' in k]
for m in mods_to_remove:
    del sys.modules[m]

sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from semver.version import Version

# Test cases from m2 spec
v1 = Version.parse('1.2.3+alpha')
result1 = v1.bump_build()
print(f"alpha bump_build: {result1} (expected: 1.2.3+alpha.0)")
assert str(result1) == '1.2.3+alpha.0', f"FAIL: got {result1}"

v2 = Version.parse('1.2.3+build.9')
result2 = v2.bump_build()
print(f"build.9 bump_build: {result2} (expected: 1.2.3+build.10)")
assert str(result2) == '1.2.3+build.10', f"FAIL: got {result2}"

v3 = Version.parse('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9')
result3 = v3.bump_build()
print(f"rc.1+build.9 bump_build: {result3} (expected: 3.4.5-rc.1+build.10)")
assert str(result3) == '3.4.5-rc.1+build.10', f"FAIL: got {result3}"

# Also test no existing build metadata
v4 = Version.parse('1.2.3')
result4 = v4.bump_build()
print(f"no build bump_build: {result4} (expected: 1.2.3+build.1)")
assert str(result4) == '1.2.3+build.1', f"FAIL: got {result4}"

print("\nAll m2 tests passed!")
